'''Surface-to-air missiles''' were a type of [[Missile/Legends|missile]] designed to be launched from the surface and strike airborne targets. [[Golog-Bertum]]'s [[Apex Incisor Missile]] was a specific model of surface-to-air missile.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
